info.title: Ofdrw.Net CLI
info.description: Command-line DOCX, PDF, OFD, and SVG conversion tool for Ofdrw.Net.

commands.name: convert
commands.description:
Infer conversion direction from .docx/.pdf/.ofd extensions.
docx-to-pdf Convert DOCX to PDF using Word on macOS when available, or LibreOffice.
docx-to-ofd Convert DOCX directly to native OFD text, or use a dual visual/text layer.
text-to-ofd Convert strict UTF-8 plain text to native OFD with Flow pagination.

options.name: --input
options.description: Input file path.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path.

options.name: --pages
options.description: 1-based page list or ranges, for example 1,3-5.

options.name: --ppm
options.description: Image commands: finite positive pixels per millimeter; default 144/25.4.

options.name: --format
options.description:
ofd-to-image: png (default) or jpeg, independent of filename.
--jpeg-quality ofd-to-image: quality 1-100 (default 90).
image-to-ofd: use --output, or a final positional .ofd destination; inputs retain argument order.
--page-width, --page-height image-to-ofd: paired dimensions in millimeters; default natural image size.
--max-pixels, --max-working-bytes, --max-input-bytes, --max-output-bytes Image command budgets.
--max-pdf-bytes, --max-signature-appearances ofd-to-image: PDF bytes / selected stamp count budgets.
--max-total-input-bytes, --max-pages, --max-entries image-to-ofd: cumulative input/page/entry budgets.
--include-templates Include template text during extraction.

options.name: --skip-unsupported
options.description: Drop unsupported raw objects during merge.

options.name: --docx-engine
options.description: DOCX renderer: auto, word (macOS), libreoffice, or built-in.

options.name: --docx-ofd-mode
options.description: DOCX to OFD mode: native (default, no PDF) or dual-layer.

options.name: --libreoffice
options.description: Path to the LibreOffice soffice executable for DOCX conversion.

options.name: --font-directory
options.description: Additional font directory for DOCX rendering; may be repeated.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

commands.name: merge
commands.description: Merge OFD pages into a self-contained output document.

commands.name: mix
commands.description:
Overlay source/page pairs in input order, first page dimensions.
clean-signatures Remove all declarations and unreferenced owned signature payloads.

commands.name: ofd-to-pdf
commands.description: Convert OFD to PDF.

commands.name: ofd-to-svg
commands.description:
Convert one OFD page to self-contained SVG.
ofd-to-html Convert selected OFD pages to a static HTML preview.
ofd-to-image Export one OFD page to white-background PNG (default) or JPEG.
image-to-ofd Import PNG/JPEG, one image per page; centered, shrink to fit, no enlargement.
verify-signatures Verify protected-entry digests and registered signed-value algorithms.
extract-text Extract page text, optionally including template text.
replace-text Replace literal simple text using vetted original Regular fonts and translation-only geometry.

commands.name: pdf-to-ofd
commands.description: Convert PDF to OFD.

commands.name: reorder
commands.description: Reorder every page using a complete 1-based page list.

commands.name: split
commands.description: Select distinct pages in 1-based list order into a new OFD.

commands.name: watermark
commands.description: Add ordinary text/image objects to selected layers (millimeters).

commands.description: Merge OFD pages into a self-contained output document.
